subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Major
solution:
The correct answer is 'considerable'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Major**' means important, serious, or significant (प्रमुख).

 
 
• **Example**- "The use of drugs is a major problem."
 
 
 
• 'Considerable' means notably large in size, amount, or extent. (विचारणीय)
 
 
• **Example**- "A position of considerable influence"
 
 
 
• Hence the option that is similar in meaning to the given word is '**Considerable**'.

Therefore, the correct option is '**Option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• **Diligent **means showing care and effort in your work or duties (परिश्रमी, सावधान और कर्मठ).
 
• **Shallow **means not deep; with not much distance between top and bottom (छिछला, गहरा नहीं; जिसकी ऊपरी सतह और तले के बीच दूरी कम हो).
 
• **Creviced **means a narrow fissure or crack; split; cleft (दरारयुक्त).
